rows.resolution_note: p008 sentence 146 defines the pQTL data as the authors' own sex-stratified GWAS on protein levels in 30,272 selected Caucasian UK Biobank individuals (REGENIE, project 44986, summary statistics deposited by the authors, p013): an own analysis of individual-level data defined by an analysis procedure, not a listed release (rule C).
rows.quote: To investigate genetic effects on blood proteins by sex, we conducted sex-stratified GWAS on protein levels using the proteome data from the 30,272 selected Caucasian individuals and compared variants’ effect on protein between males and females.
rows.dataset_named_in_source: sex-stratified GWAS on protein levels using the proteome data from the 30,272 selected Caucasian individuals
